newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise Medical amends rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise Medical amends rights plan.

text.p: Sunrise Medical Inc, a maker of home- and extended-care medical products, said it has amended its stockholder rights plan.

In a statement issued late on Friday, the company lowered the ownership threshold that triggers the plan to 15 percent from 25 percent. It increased the exercise price of the rights to $60.00 from $55.00, and it extended the termination date of the rights plan to May 16, 2007 from May 7, 2000.
The company said the amendments were made as a normal course of business and were not a result of a specific attempt to acquire control of the company.
